register_note_zh: 八维风险登记表覆盖组织方完整风险清单；评分 1-5；得分 4 及以上必须写明人工复核路径与停用条件，且停用条件为硬性约束。
register_note_en: Eight dimensions cover every entry of the organiser risk list. Scores run from 1 to 5; a score of 4 or above must state a human-review path and a stop condition, and the stop condition is a hard constraint.

dimensions.note_en: 13 scenario cards cover personal trajectories (SC-AI-01/04/07), senior identity (SC-AI-SEN), and enterprise data directories (SC-AI-06/08). Sensitive scenarios are documented in [evidence:visual/assets/lifecycle-om-framework.json] (4-tier data retention) + [evidence:visual/assets/asset-clearance-register.json].
dimensions.mitigation_en: All scenarios default to no PII collection; required scenarios need user authorization; external transmission limited to minimised & one-way pseudonymised data; 7 sensitive scenarios (SC-AI-02/04/06/07/08/10/SEN) declare data-flow table (local vs external, lawful basis, deletion method, human review, shutdown trigger).
dimensions.human_review_en: PIPL-2021 + Data Security Law 2021 compliance pre-audit; third-party PIA report required before pilot; scenario cards with PII cannot launch before PIA passes.
dimensions.trigger: 任一敏感场景卡需采集超出场景最低必要的数据项时
dimensions.evidence: proposal.md §13 张场景卡安全敏感度数据流表；lifecycle-om-framework.json；asset-clearance-register.json
dimensions.stop_condition: PIA 未通过或数据合规阻断 (F2) 时，相关场景卡进入暂停状态
dimensions.owner_role: 治理委员会 + 数据保护官 + 场景运营方
dimensions.label: 数据与个人信息
dimensions.note: 本包 13 张场景卡涉及个人轨迹（SC-AI-01/04/07）、老年身份（SC-AI-SEN）、企业数据目录（SC-AI-06/08）等敏感维度。所有敏感场景卡已写入 [evidence:visual/assets/lifecycle-om-framework.json] 4 类数据分级 + [evidence:visual/assets/asset-clearance-register.json] 资产清权表。
dimensions.mitigation: 全场景默认不采集个人识别信息；必要场景需用户授权；外部传输仅限最小化与单向脱敏；7 张敏感场景卡（SC-AI-02/04/06/07/08/10/SEN）逐卡声明数据流（本地 vs 外部、合法授权、删除方式、人工复核、关停触发）。
dimensions.human_review: PIPL-2021 + 数据安全法-2021 合规预审；试点前由具备个人信息合规审计资质的第三方出具独立 PIA 报告；未通过 PIA 之前相关场景卡不得启用。

dimensions.note_en: Scope covers 3 key areas + 9.3 km Green Spine + Jingzhang heritage; current-building survey, municipal, rail interface, underground-space data all missing (A-DATA-004 / A-CONTROLS-003 / A-ENG-005 / A-RAIL-006 gaps); every concrete facility needs independent deepening by qualified teams.
dimensions.mitigation_en: All engineering values (height / FAR / area / road redline / municipal load / tree count) labelled as 未验证设计假设 in proposal.md §3.4; numeric indicators (investment pre-v4.3 数字区间 yi_rmb changed to status=unknown + value=null) are not implementation conclusions.
dimensions.human_review_en: Independent feasibility reports from qualified teams; no facility enters construction-drawing phase before sign-off.
dimensions.trigger: 任一具体设施进入立项或施工图阶段时
dimensions.stop_condition: 相关专业报告未签字或控规未获批时，设施不进入实施
dimensions.owner_role: 属地主管部门 + 设计联合体 + 实施主体
dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: 本方案范围跨 3 处重点区 + 9.3 km 绿脉中枢 + 京张铁路遗产；现状建筑、市政管线、轨道接口、地下空间等专项资料缺失（A-DATA-004 / A-CONTROLS-003 / A-ENG-005 / A-RAIL-006 缺口）；任何一项具体设施落地须由具备市政、交通、给排水、轨道、消防资质的专业团队独立深化。
dimensions.mitigation: 已在 proposal.md §3.4 标记所有高度 / FAR / 面积 / 道路红线 / 市政负荷 / 树木数量为未验证设计假设；任何指标性数字（投资 pre-v4.3 数字区间 亿元已改为 status=unknown + value=null）不作为实施结论。
dimensions.human_review: 由具备市政、交通、给排水、轨道、消防资质的专业团队出具专项可行性报告；任何报告未签字前相关设施不进入施工图阶段。

dimensions.note_en: 5 personas (incl. seniors) + 13 scenario cards; public hearing + complaint response (BL-P3) before any scenario launch.
dimensions.mitigation_en: proposal.md §11 public interest: refusal / withdrawal / human review; SC-AI-SEN senior scenario includes family SMS confirmation + fully-manual fallback; annual resident participation fund ≤ 20M yuan [A-PARTICIPATION-018].
dimensions.human_review_en: Community council + senior representative + sub-district office; consecutive 2-quarter complaint cluster (F4/F7) triggers scenario downgrade.
dimensions.trigger: 任一场景卡上线后出现用户拒绝率 > 30% 或投诉集中时
dimensions.stop_condition: F3 / F4 / F7 任一失败模式触发时进入暂停或降级状态
dimensions.owner_role: 治理委员会 + 社区议事会 + 邻里管家
dimensions.label: 公共接受度
dimensions.note: 本方案涉及 5 类用户画像（含老年群体）+ 13 张场景卡；任何场景卡上线前需经用户反馈回路与公开听证（[evidence:visual/assets/baseline-protocols.json] BL-P3 投诉响应）。
dimensions.mitigation: 提案 §11 公共利益已声明可拒绝 / 退出 / 人工复核机制；SC-AI-SEN 银龄场景特别包含家属短信确认 + 全人工保留入口；年居民参与金 ≤ 2000 万元（[A-PARTICIPATION-018]）。
dimensions.human_review: 由社区议事会 + 老年代表 + 街道办共同审议；连续两季度投诉集中 (F4/F7) 触发场景降级。

dimensions.note_en: 10-year cumulative OPEX conceptual range 15-45 yi_rmb; specific cost depends on labor, energy, review frequency, etc.; needs 6-month operational baseline.
dimensions.mitigation_en: [evidence:visual/assets/parametric-cost-model.json] defines 4 OPEX dimensions as pending_baseline; candidate operators + qualifications registered in [evidence:visual/assets/operator-qualification.json].
dimensions.human_review_en: Financial + industry expert + operator quarterly budget review; quarterly public dashboard.
dimensions.trigger: 任一年度预算超概念区间上限 1.5 倍时
dimensions.stop_condition: 成本失控或运营亏损持续 2 年时启动退出机制
dimensions.owner_role: 运营方 + 财务 + 治理委员会
dimensions.label: 运营成本
dimensions.note: 本方案 10 年累计运营 (OPEX) 概念区间 15-pending_baseline元；具体运营成本受人力、能源、复核频次等多项变量影响，需运营 6 个月后实测基线。
dimensions.mitigation: 已在 [evidence:visual/assets/parametric-cost-model.json] 定义 4 个 OPEX 维度（年度运营费 / 治理委员会预算 / 居民参与金 / 银龄 AI 邻里客厅）均为 pending_baseline；运营主体候选与资质登记在 [evidence:visual/assets/operator-qualification.json]。
dimensions.human_review: 由财务 + 行业专家 + 运营方共同审议年度预算；季度公开仪表盘。

dimensions.note_en: Multi-jurisdiction (Haidian + Zhongguancun + National Railway + Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei + SOE); no existing formal authorization for cross-region agreements / fiscal budgets / SOE cooperation ([evidence:visual/assets/operator-qualification.json] + [evidence:visual/assets/capacity-preassessment.json]).
dimensions.mitigation_en: Every cross-region / cross-party statement has 就地 limits '建议 / 待协商 / 无现有协议'; all responsible parties marked as candidate + pending; no party may be advertised as partner before formal authorization ([source:PROJECT-AGENT-OPEN-CALL-TASKBOOK]).
dimensions.human_review_en: Haidian Bureau + Zhongguancun + cross-jurisdiction joint review; new cooperation must go through formal approval.
dimensions.trigger: 任何官方政策、控制性规划、合作框架发生变动时
dimensions.stop_condition: 官方撤回 / 修订任何相关政策时，相关条款需重新审议
dimensions.owner_role: 海淀分局 + 跨界联席机制
dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: 本方案涉及海淀区 + 中关村 + 国铁集团 + 京津冀 + 央国企等多主体；当前所有跨区协议 / 财政预算 / 央国企合作均无现有正式授权（[evidence:visual/assets/operator-qualification.json] + [evidence:visual/assets/capacity-preassessment.json]）。
dimensions.mitigation: 所有跨区、跨主体表述就地加上'建议、待协商、无现有协议'限定；所有责任主体标注为候选 + 待指定；正式授权文件签订前相关主体不得被宣传为合作方（[source:PROJECT-AGENT-OPEN-CALL-TASKBOOK]）。
dimensions.human_review: 由海淀分局 + 中关村管委会 + 跨界联席机制审议；任何新增合作须走正式审批。

dimensions.note_en: All geometry based on provisional boundary (A-DATA-004 gap); site_area_sqm = 11,412,825.386 sqm is current-package EPSG:4548 recompute (removed 'sole authoritative' wording). Official polygon triggers full recompute.
dimensions.mitigation_en: [evidence:visual/assets/statutory-reconciliation.json] defines L1/L2/L3 conflict levels + dispositions; all derived-metric differences logged in ledger + 90-day public disclosure.
dimensions.human_review_en: GIS professional team + statutory planning unit joint review; all recompute differences verified by independent third-party.
dimensions.stop_condition: 官方 polygon 发布后，整体重算未完成前不得对外发布新指标
dimensions.owner_role: GIS 专业团队 + 控规编制单位
dimensions.label: 空间边界争议
dimensions.note: 本方案全部几何基于 provisional 边界（A-DATA-004 缺口）；metrics.json 中 site_area_sqm = 11,412,825.386 sqm 仅为当前包内 EPSG:4548 投影面积复算结果（已移除'唯一权威'措辞）。官方 polygon 发布后必须整体重算。
dimensions.mitigation: [evidence:visual/assets/statutory-reconciliation.json] 定义 L1/L2/L3 冲突等级与处置预案；所有衍生指标差异记入台账并随 90 天公示期披露。
dimensions.human_review: 由 GIS 专业团队 + 法定控规编制单位共同审议；任何重算差异须经第三方独立测算验证。

dimensions.note_en: 13 scenario cards involve LLM / multimodal / red-team / senior AI capabilities; performance, latency, safety, SLA all unverified design targets ([evidence:visual/assets/accessibility-mapping.json]); no current capability claimed.
dimensions.mitigation_en: Every card marked 'design target / to be tested'; SC-AI-10 red-team sandbox + F1-F8 failure modes ([evidence:visual/assets/failure-modes.json]) as continuous validation.
dimensions.human_review_en: AI safety research + ethics committee + governance committee; P95 > 2x baseline or accuracy < 85% triggers F1 failure mode.
dimensions.trigger: 任一场景卡性能持续 2 周劣化时
dimensions.evidence: proposal.md §2.1 SC-AI 技术路径示例；visual/assets/failure-modes.json
dimensions.stop_condition: 失败模式 F1-F8 任一触发且无法在 24 小时内降级时，场景卡暂停
dimensions.owner_role: AI 安全研究 + 伦理委员会 + 治理委员会
dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: 本方案 13 张场景卡涉及 LLM / 多模态 / 红队测试 / 银龄 AI 等多种 AI 能力；模型性能、时延、安全率、SLA 均为未验证设计目标 ([evidence:visual/assets/accessibility-mapping.json])；当前不主张任何能力已达成。
dimensions.mitigation: 每张场景卡标注'设计目标/待试验'；SC-AI-10 红队沙盒 + F1-F8 失败模式（[evidence:visual/assets/failure-modes.json]）作为持续验证机制。
dimensions.human_review: 由 AI 安全研究机构 + 伦理委员会 + 治理委员会共同审议；任何 P95 > 2× 基线或准确率 < 85% 触发 F1 失败模式。

dimensions.note_en: 5 personas incl. seniors; SC-AI-SEN forces non-digital equivalent path + fully-manual fallback + refusal-triggered downgrade; machine-vision self-check does not substitute for professional accessibility certification; P5 third-party audit carries field certification.
dimensions.mitigation_en: P1-P5 commitment thresholds ([evidence:visual/assets/commitment-thresholds.json]) + accessibility design intent mapping ([evidence:visual/assets/accessibility-mapping.json]) + baseline protocols ([evidence:visual/assets/baseline-protocols.json]).
dimensions.human_review_en: Accessibility professional + senior representative + neighbourhood housekeeper; P5 third-party audit failure blocks scenario launch.
dimensions.trigger: 可拒绝率 > 30% 或 P5 审计不通过时
dimensions.stop_condition: 可拒绝率连续 2 季度 > 30% 时 SC-AI-SEN 进入暂停
dimensions.owner_role: 无障碍专业团队 + 老年代表 + 治理委员会
dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: 本方案覆盖 5 类用户画像（含老年）；SC-AI-SEN 银龄场景强制非数字化等价路径 + 全人工保留 + 可拒绝触发降级；机器视觉自检不替代专业无障碍认证；现场认证由 P5 第三方无障碍审计承载。
dimensions.mitigation: P1-P5 承诺阈值 ([evidence:visual/assets/commitment-thresholds.json]) + 无障碍设计意图映射 ([evidence:visual/assets/accessibility-mapping.json]) + 基线测量协议 ([evidence:visual/assets/baseline-protocols.json])。
dimensions.human_review: 由无障碍专业团队 + 老年代表 + 邻里管家共同审议；P5 第三方无障碍审计不通过时场景卡不启动。
